# Classical definitions in the grammar

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`classical-definitions-in-the-grammar` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](classical-definitions-in-the-grammar.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Definitions of the frozen corpus written in the grammar hold for every carrier and relation: the 墨经's and 荀子's 化 are one form and are 成坏 along 缘, 同 is a class only where belonging is single, and continuation is neither identity nor mere difference.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. 化, read from the 墨经 (「化，徵易也」) and the 荀子 (「状变而实无别而为异者，谓之化」), is one form: continuing under the class of the thing while the class of its marks tells the two apart, which is the grammar's alteration. (`Becoming.«化»`, `Becoming.«化之二说同形»`)
2. 成坏, read from the 金师子章 (「諸根合會是成相，諸緣各住自位是壞相」), is at once alike under a coarse class and apart under a fine one; 化 is 成坏 along 缘. (`Becoming.«成坏»`, `Becoming.«化为有缘之成坏»`)
3. 同, read from the 墨经 (「同，異而俱於之一也」), is sameness in belonging to one; it is a class exactly where each belongs to one and one only, and otherwise need not be transitive. (`Becoming.«同于»`, `Becoming.«同于为类»`, `Becoming.«同于不必传递»`)
4. 复, read from the 老子 (「復命曰常」), is a line returning to where it was; what returns abides. 通, read from the 系辞 (「往來不窮謂之通」), is a line that never ends; under a constant class a line with a past passes through. (`Becoming.«复»`, `Becoming.«相续之末有前»`, `Becoming.«复者住»`, `Becoming.«通»`, `Becoming.«有常则通»`)
5. Neither one nor other: in a net without self-conditioning there is no continuation under identity, and every 缘 is a continuation under some class while identity tells its ends apart. The 中论's 「滅更不生故，因即為斷滅」 holds under identity while the same 缘 is a continuation under a coarser class. (`Becoming.«非一非异»`, `Becoming.«因灭而续»`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Each reading of a sentence as a definition is an AI reconstruction following the commentary named in the classification; the sense lost in it is recorded in the plan.
- Equality on the carrier is a model commitment where identity is the class.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That these readings are the texts' own sense: the 墨经's 化 is also one of six kinds of action, and the 金师子章's 成坏 is read synchronically against the 中论's 「成壞相違，云何一時有」.
- That the 中论's dilemma is answered: whether a condition must still be present when what it conditions arises is not expressible without a relation of co-presence, which the grammar lacks.
- That every kind of 同 in the 墨经 is a class: 類同 is not transitive by itself. Witness: `Becoming.«同于不必传递»`.
- **Counterexample:** Belonging to two: 0 and 1 share 10, 1 and 2 share 20, 0 and 2 share nothing («同于不必传递»). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarReadings.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation.
